CVE-2025-62615.detail: Routes RSS downloads through AutoGPT's SSRF-aware Requests wrapper, which validates resolved destinations and blocks private or reserved IP ranges while retaining the 10 MB response limit.

CVE-2026-32718.detail: The fix changes both cloud-token and server validation routes from the read ability to the write ability, so read-only API tokens can no longer invoke these state-changing validation operations.

CVE-2026-39974.detail: The fix rejects unsafe instance URLs during header validation and again with a DNS-aware check before use, blocking invalid protocols, embedded credentials, fragments, metadata hosts, localhost, and private addresses.

CVE-2026-42282.detail: The fix replaces raw tool-call argument logging with metadata-only summaries of type, key names, nesting, and approximate size, and removes argument values from validation and coercion log fields.

CVE-2026-45707.detail: In multi-tenant mode, the fix rejects requests with no tenant headers, refuses environment credential fallback for missing or incomplete tenant context, and hides operator URL/key data from trigger and diagnostic responses.

CVE-2026-46383.detail: The fix validates tar member names before legacy-bundle probing and extraction, rejecting Windows drive or UNC paths and normalized traversal or absolute paths before extractall() runs.

CVE-2026-47211.detail: The fix treats a repository's .env as untrusted and drops CLI-path, runtime-selector, and approval-mode variables before they can choose an executable or disable approval.

CVE-2026-66065.detail: Removes project-directory MCP config auto-discovery and strips additional config-home, MCP/plugin, transport, agent-root, and capability variables from untrusted .env files before they can redirect execution.

GHSA-2664-HR5V-554W.detail: Freezes both object- and function-valued global prototypes and locks key EventEmitter methods against reassignment before sandboxed code runs, closing mutations of Function.prototype and process event methods.

GHSA-2GFJ-FR43-4735.detail: The fix maps each message ID to a URL-safe encoded directory name, resolves it beneath the attachment root, and makes extraction and cleanup use that checked path instead of joining raw IDs.

GHSA-2R68-G678-7QR3.detail: The patch classifies store_memory and delete_memory as write tools and rejects their MCP dispatch with HTTP 403 / JSON-RPC -32003 unless the OAuth token has write scope.

GHSA-49MQ-FC6Q-3H46.detail: The fix removes the shell-interpolated getent and grep pipeline, invokes getent with the username as a separate argv value through execFileSafe, and performs the passwd-file fallback in process.

GHSA-4PC9-X2FX-P7VJ.detail: Makes authorization parsing asynchronous, looks up the registered client, and rejects any redirect_uri outside that client's allowlist before issuing an authorization code.

GHSA-5GVR-V6QV-H5MM.detail: The fix inserts a NUL delimiter between the session, title, and narrative fields before hashing, so different field tuples cannot collapse to the same concatenated byte string.

GHSA-6JCQ-6546-QRRW.detail: The fix makes Sandlock fail at construction when the required Landlock ABI is unavailable and removes the execute/run-command subprocess fallbacks, so weaker isolation requires an explicit caller choice.

GHSA-6MG4-788H-7G9G.detail: Escapes Jellyseerr users' display names and email addresses before inserting them into dropdown and selected-user HTML, so stored profile text cannot create executable markup in the admin page.

GHSA-72W7-MF9G-733P.detail: The fix treats every policy group with proxy settings as network-blocked by default, so direct sockets are denied and egress must use the supervised proxy path.

GHSA-75HX-XJ24-MQRW.detail: The fix requires rate-limited bearer authentication on GET and DELETE /mcp, removes the unauthenticated test route, and reduces /health to a minimal liveness response.

GHSA-7F6V-3GX7-27Q8.detail: Serializes Swagger and Scalar configuration through JSON-for-HTML escaping before embedding it in script elements, preventing specification content from terminating the script and executing markup.

GHSA-8359-H9FX-J6V9.detail: Checks that local JSON-Schema references resolve inside the input base directory and blocks out-of-tree file:// and relative paths when remote references are disabled, unless the caller explicitly allows them.

GHSA-8CCJ-P46R-JWQQ.detail: The fix stops trusting the request Host header, requires the server's actual bind address to be recorded, and permits PRAISONAI_CALL_AUTH=disabled only when that configured address is explicitly localhost.

GHSA-8G7G-HMWM-6RV2.detail: For the AI-traced path-building flaw, the fix accepts only nonempty alphanumeric, hyphen, or underscore identifiers and encodes them before inserting them into n8n API URLs.

GHSA-8X5V-CPV7-8JJP.detail: Adds a shared address check that rejects non-global IPv4 addresses hidden inside IPv6 forms, including IPv4-mapped, 6to4, Teredo, and NAT64, and applies it during resolution and connection checks.

GHSA-97RM-XJ73-33JH.detail: Replaces regex-based raw .env line construction with dotenv.parse plus dotenv-stringify before writing refreshed tokens, so token contents are encoded by the env serializer instead of becoming new assignments.

GHSA-F65R-H4G3-3H9H.detail: The fix installs an ASGI transformer on the Reflex app that authenticates HTTP requests and WebSocket upgrades before acceptance, with Host and Origin checks; the CLI now passes validated credentials and rejects unsafe public binds.

GHSA-G2G8-95QG-V35H.detail: The fix treats a quote as well as whitespace as an attribute boundary, allowing the sanitizer to remove adjacent event handlers and unsafe URL-like attributes such as href="#"onclick=....

GHSA-G8P2-7WF7-98MQ.detail: The fix stops applying a gatewayUrl query parameter immediately, holds the proposed server URL in pending state, and connects only after the user explicitly confirms it in a warning dialog.

GHSA-GWMJ-HF32-5V8V.detail: Enables the private-hostname guard for local_trusted deployments as well as authenticated private deployments, so requests with unapproved Host headers are rejected before actor assignment.

GHSA-H5RM-9FHH-5PHJ.detail: Rejects separators, NULs, and dot path components in node types, then resolves each schema module's real path and loads it only when it remains inside the configured nodes directory.

GHSA-HHJV-JQ77-CMVX.detail: The fix parses rm arguments and requires recursive and force flags as a set, so flag reordering, combination, and long-form spellings cannot bypass the destructive-command block.

GHSA-J6R7-6FHX-77WX.detail: The patch derives a hashed tenant key from each n8n API URL and API key, stores it on workflow-version rows, filters all version operations by it, purges legacy unscoped backups, and removes global truncate.

GHSA-JP7M-XCGX-57QM.detail: Detects $secrets references inside expression blocks despite whitespace or line breaks and passes the caller's externalSecret:list permission into resolver validation, preventing unauthorized secret resolution.

GHSA-P7MM-R948-4Q3Q.detail: The fix removes decidedByUserId from request validators and derives it from the authenticated actor for approve, reject, and request-revision operations, preventing clients from forging decision attribution.

GHSA-PFM2-2MHG-8WPX.detail: Removes pre-authentication request-detail logging, replaces raw JSON-RPC payloads with metadata-only summaries, and redacts sensitive headers in post-authentication logs.

GHSA-PJ2R-F9MW-VRCQ.detail: The fix stops copying the parent environment and builds each MCP subprocess environment from a small platform-safe baseline plus variables explicitly supplied by the caller.

GHSA-PQH8-P93P-2RX7.detail: The fix validates timeframes and filters and escapes quoted identifiers before building DQL, preventing input from adding query stages or breaking out of strings.

GHSA-Q6QC-XP4Q-RJQ5.detail: The fix makes authentication the default by generating and storing an owner-only token when none is configured, rejects every non-health request without a matching bearer, cookie, or bootstrap query token, and makes the CLI send that token automatically.

GHSA-Q9P7-WQXG-MRHC.detail: Adds a curated builtins dictionary and passes it explicitly to each eval of generated pandas expressions, preventing Python from exposing dangerous builtins such as __import__, eval, exec, and open.

GHSA-QGP8-V765-QXX9.detail: Rejects a token request that supplies code_verifier when the stored authorization grant has no codeChallenge, closing the PKCE downgrade mismatch before any tokens are issued.

GHSA-QPMQ-6WJC-W28Q.detail: Rebuilds Discord-member options and selected-user displays with DOM APIs and textContent, and assigns avatar src only after URL validation, eliminating the stored-markup injection path.

GHSA-RFR2-MQ9M-X2QX.detail: The fix blocks localhost and non-public IP targets by default, disables automatic redirects, and revalidates every redirect destination before fetching it.

GHSA-V52W-28XH-V562.detail: The patch validates Host and Origin on the MCP HTTP listener, limits MCP request bodies, returns generic server errors, and makes generated unauthenticated listener bindings loopback-only.

GHSA-VVFR-G83F-8QCV.detail: Tracks keys loaded from each profile, removes those keys from os.environ before loading the next profile, and then applies the new profile's environment values.

GHSA-W6H2-FR4Q-XVXV.detail: The fix shell-quotes file and directory path arguments before constructing the compute-provider cat and ls commands, closing the quoted-path breakout demonstrated by this case.

GHSA-WRWR-H859-XH2R.detail: The fix converts attrkey and charkey to strings in the options object itself before checking forbidden XML names, so xml2js receives the same validated values instead of later re-coercing attacker-controlled objects.

GHSA-XW8C-RRVX-F7XQ.detail: The patch reads at most 5 MiB plus one byte from both SCA HTTP clients, rejects oversized bodies before JSON decoding, and keeps normal in-limit responses working.
